note: The IEDOM's observatory of bank charges for private customers (its half-yearly report of April 2026, prices at 1 April 2026), Mayotte's table: the yearly price of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept. On 2026-10-30 the banks' own price lists were sought for their full ranges: the BFCOI's site answered with an Incapsula check (not circumvented) and BRED's tariffs page refused the connection; the IEDOM table stays the source.
